meta.title: Recommended grouping prompts are listed and paste into the chat input

args.goal: With the Smart Grouping side panel already open, verify that recommended prompts including Group by product category, Create balanced groups, and Group by delivery location are visible; click one recommended prompt and stop with the AI chat input showing the pasted instruction and a non-empty value.

steps.note: The catalog has no Smart Grouping-specific action, so this performs and observes the prompt selection and paste directly on the current buyer screen.
Confirms the AI chat input remains present after the prompt was selected.
